thread:
Sam (Marketing): Quick ask — need a lightweight visual kit for next week's launch: 1) benchmark 1-pager, 2) email hero variants for 3 nurture tracks, 3) two social card sizes. Priority: clarity on inference economics story + modular CTA so sales can swap. Target: comps in 36h, final exports in 4 days. Thoughts?

Priya (Design): On it. Which nurture tracks? And do we need animated web hero or purely static assets?

Sam (Marketing): Tracks: Platform/SRE, Product Managers, Founders/ICs. Emails must be static PNG. Web hero can have a subtle micro-animation, but not required for MVP. Include alt-text suggestions.

Theo (Creative Ops): We'll supply a Figma kit + exported PNG/JPG/SVG. Also can add a modular number overlay component for sales. Any localization needs?

Sam (Marketing): Yes — APAC (en + ja) and EU locale (en + de). Keep copy short; I'll drop localized strings tomorrow. Also include a social microtile with a short stat overlay option.

Priya (Design): Draft asset spec: 
- Email hero: 700x240 (mobile-safe 600x200), PNG @2x, 3 copy lanes per segment
- Social wide: 1200x630 PNG, Social square: 800x800 SVG
- Benchmark 1-pager: PDF letter + 1080x1920 vertical PNG for stories
- Component kit: CTA module (Demo / Try API), stat overlay, logo lockups (light/dark)
- Deliverables: Figma file, flattened PNGs, SVGs, PDFs, README for sales

Noor (Legal): Heads-up — any explicit comparative claims or specific percent numbers need source files. Otherwise use conservative language ("up to" or "can reduce"). We'll review final copy in 24h.

Sam (Marketing): Will avoid absolutes. I'll post the benchmark deck link shortly (internal only).

asset-bot: Task created: A-8842 "launch-mini-visual-kit" assigned to Priya, Theo. Due dates: comps + review 36h, final assets 4d.

Priya (Design): Quick brand tokens: Redwood Sans, Accent: #4B7CFF / #0FAF8E, Neutral: scale in figma. Any required icon set?

Theo (Creative Ops): Use /assets/icons/rebrand for icons. I'll add export presets and a sample sales CSV to swap stat values. Also drafting a short readme for accessibility and email alt text.

Sam (Marketing): Great. Please tag me when initial comps are up. If anything blocks (font access, figma perms), ping here.

Priya (Design): Starting comps now. ETA: screenshots in thread within 18 hours.

Noor (Legal): I'll stand by for the review pass.

Theo (Creative Ops): Copy for CTAs: "Request demo" / "Start free trial" / "Try the API" — put as interchangeable buttons in Figma.

Sam (Marketing): Perfect — thanks team.
